headline: DSK Legal, Khaitan & Co act on Sunsure Energy securing ₹262 crore project finance from FMO, Axis Bank
sum: Sunsure Energy Private Limited and its group companies have secured ₹262 crore project financing from Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V. (FMO) and Axis Bank Limited, by way of private placement of secured,…
detail: Sunsure Energy Private Limited and its group companies have secured ₹262 crore project financing from Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V. (FMO) and Axis Bank Limited, by way of private placement of secured, unlisted, redeemable, non-convertible debentures. DSK Legal advised Sunsure Energy on this transaction. The Firm advised and assisted in reviewing and negotiating the transaction documentation and advising Sunsure Energy on matters relating to listing, security creation and perfection.
